props.gloss_en: the Rabbis: pupils came today to the study hall and said things the like of which were not said even in the days of Joshua bin Nun
alef-beit: learn (elaf) understanding (bina)
gimmel-dalet: be bountiful to the poor (gemol dalim)
why is the gimmel's leg stretched toward the dalet? because it is the way of one who bestows kindness to run after the poor
and why is the dalet's leg stretched toward the gimmel? that [the poor man] make himself available to him
and why does the dalet turn its face from the gimmel? that he give to him in secret, so that [the poor man] not be shamed before him
heh-vav: this is the name of the Holy One, blessed be He
zayin-chet, tet-yod, kaf-lamed: and if you do so, the Holy One feeds you, favours you, does you good, gives you an inheritance, and ties a crown for you in the world to come
open mem, closed mem: an open saying, a closed saying
bent nun, straight nun: a faithful one bent, a faithful one straight
samekh-ayin: support the poor (smoch aniyim)
another version: make mnemonic signs (simanim ase) in the Torah and acquire it
bent peh, straight peh: an open mouth, a closed mouth
bent tzadi and straight tzadi: a righteous one bent, a righteous one straight
the script added for you bending upon his bending; from here, that the Torah was given with bowed head
kuf: holy (kadosh); resh: wicked (rasha)
why does the kuf turn its face from the resh? the Holy One said: I cannot look upon the wicked
and why does the kuf's crown turn toward the resh? the Holy One said: if he repents, I tie for him a crown like Mine
and why does the kuf's leg hang [detached]? that if he repents, he may enter [through the gap]

Reish Lakish: what is meant by 'if it concerns the scorners, He scorns them, and to the humble He gives grace' (Prov 3:34)? one who comes to defile himself -- they open for him; one who comes to purify himself -- they help him
shin: falsehood (sheker); tav: truth (emet)
why are the letters of sheker near one another and those of emet far apart? falsehood is common, truth is not common
and why does falsehood stand on one leg and truth on brick-like bases? truth endures, falsehood does not endure

alef-tav beit-shin: he loathed Me -- shall I desire him? he did not desire Me -- shall My name rest on him? gimmel-resh: he defiled his body -- shall I pity him? dalet-kuf: he locked My doors -- shall I not cut off his horns? thus far the attribute of the wicked

but the attribute of the righteous: alef-tav beit-shin -- if you are abashed; gimmel-resh dalet-kuf -- if you do so, dwell on high (bedok); heh-tzadi vav-peh -- a partition is between you and anger; zayin-ayin chet-samekh tet-nun -- and you will not tremble before the Satan
yod-mem kaf-lamed: the [officer of] Gehinnom said before the Holy One: Master of the world, into the sea [send] all

the Holy One said: alef-chet-samekh beit-tet-ayin gimmel-yod-peh -- I pity them, for they spurned adultery; dalet-kaf-tzadi -- they are pure, they are honest, they are righteous; heh-lamed-kuf -- you have no portion in them
vav-mem-resh-zayin-nun shin-tav: Gehinnom said before Him: Master of the world, my Master, sustain me from the seed of Seth
He said to him: alef-lamed beit-mem [not with them]; gimmel-nun dalet-samekh -- where shall I lead them? to the garden of myrtle
heh-ayin vav-peh: Gehinnom said before the Holy One: Master of the world, I am weary
zayin-tzadi chet-kuf: these are the seed of Isaac; tet-resh yod-shin kaf-tav: wait -- I have bands upon bands of the nations of the world which I give you
